archetypes.name: tally-parse-rate
archetypes.rationale: Live parse-rate quorum changes are central to the diff.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the tally-code-votes.sh parse-rate integration and python/test_review_tally.py coverage. Verify legacy and three-slot voter-tool labels are threaded correctly, non-OK statuses are excluded, and effective voter counts remain stable for missing or empty voters. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-drift
archetypes.rationale: This change updates multiple lint and structural harnesses.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the Makefile shard target rename, prompt-template stub cleanup, retired-script lint avoidance, and research structure pins together. Confirm the harness docs match behavior and no stale retry-era or sidecar wording remains in the touched surfaces. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
